cost_assumptions_note: Monetary figures ($5 FP, $25 FN) are illustrative placeholder assumptions.
description: Cost-minimizing decision threshold selected on validation data

LOW: Low risk. Proceed with standard friction-free checkout and processing.
MEDIUM: Medium risk. Monitor order and apply standard post-order verification.
HIGH: High risk. Apply targeted friction (e.g. sizing confirmation, return policy prompt).
VERY_HIGH: Very high risk. Manual review or require prepaid verification before fulfillment.
